column1: # ISY503 Assessment 3 - group presentation video edit list.
# One row per slide, in playback order. Tab-separated.
# mode      passthru = clip already shows the slides (Teams screen-share) -> normalise only
#           pip      = clip is bare webcam -> composite over the rendered slide, Teams-style
#           missing  = not recorded yet; build.sh skips it and warns
# in/out    seconds in the SOURCE file; "-" for "to the end". Used to trim dead air,
#           and to split one source across two slides if needed.
